plain_description.what: Completes a missing certification on 20 Newsgroups for a tree built with the 512-dimension, 0.0145-bar settings (100 leaves). It runs the null test that had earlier crashed with an out-of-memory error. No judge calls.
plain_description.why: It tests whether these construction settings carry over unchanged to a new corpus.
plain_description.information: Certification would show the settings transfer whole. Result: done. The tree builds but does not certify: the root and both first-level splits fail their null. Only 1 of 97 sites certifies, which is descriptive. On this corpus the earlier transfer result rests on the 256-dimension, 0.025-bar tree alone. The two recipes cannot be ranked against each other.
